summary: PIN 6-digit auth refactor + Forgot/Reset OTP flow tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing (PIN validation 4→422 / 5→422 / 6→200, PIN login 200/401, pin-forgot stores bcrypt hash + expires in Mongo for both known and unknown emails, pin-reset returns 401 on wrong code and 400 when no active request, full E2E reset with injected hash succeeds and clears pin_reset_code_hash, new PIN works via pin-login, Stripe webhook signature validation returns 400 — no regression). Frontend: Register page correctly shows Nome+Cognome for client role and concatenates into `name` on submit; SetupSecurity PIN save-button remains disabled at 4/5 digits and enables at 6 digits, POST /api/auth/pin returns 200; Login PIN step displays '6 cifre per <email>' with maxLength=6, submit disabled until 6 digits, forgot-pin-link data-testid points to /forgot-pin?email=<encoded>; ForgotPin page shows email prefilled, advances to verify step on send, submit disabled unless code=6 AND newPin=6, invalid code triggers 'Codice non valido.' toast and stays on verify step; auto-Face-ID skipped correctly when localStorage.last_email is absent (page renders normally).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1500+ lines — consider splitting auth routes (PIN, WebAuthn, password reset) into a dedicated `auth_router.py` module for maintainability.

pin_reset_expires is stored as ISO string; if the string is somehow missing/malformed, the fallback silently sets exp to past — acceptable but consider raising 400 'reset scaduto' explicitly to distinguish from wrong-code cases.

In `send_pin_reset_code` and other email helpers the user name is interpolated directly into HTML — for defence-in-depth, HTML-escape the name (though the app trusts registered users, it's a minor XSS hygiene concern for future admin-triggered flows).
test_credentials: francesco@gmail.com / francesco123 — PIN reset back to 123456 at end of test suite. Test users created: test_pin_<ts>@example.com and test_flow_<ts>@example.com (client, password 'password123', PIN 246810).
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral client accounts created via /api/auth/register with TEST_ analog prefix (test_pin_, test_flow_). No merchant/admin data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All PIN 6-digit + forgot-pin OTP flows verified. francesco@gmail.com PIN is 123456 (restored at end of test_pin_reset_full_flow_success). Backend pin-forgot writes bcrypt hash to `pin_reset_code_hash` and ISO expiry to `pin_reset_expires`; pin-reset unsets both on success. Frontend ForgotPin uses data-testids: forgot-pin-page/email/send/code/new/confirm/submit/success. Auto-Face-ID triggers only if localStorage.last_email is set — clear it before login-page tests for fresh users.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
